card_scope: Cervical squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma detection at three tiers — pre-cancerous CIN3 detection (screening), invasive cancer detection (diagnostic), and post-treatment surveillance — across five active specimen pathways with pap smear liquid-based cytology as the primary clinical specimen.

clinical_claim.v0_1_claim: None at v0.1. Card is exploratory_with_cohort_heterogeneity per master README v2.1 tier definition.
what_card_does_NOT_claim: Pre-diagnostic blood detection of cervical cancer or CIN3
LBC pap smear detection of CIN3 or cervical cancer (VAL-076 transferability flag; VAL-077 data integrity flag)
Cross-cohort tissue replication of CIN3 detection (VAL-074 negative-direction)
Concordance with published clinical-grade cervical methylation panels (FAM19A4/miR124-2 [QIAsure AUC 0.77], ZNF671 [GynTect], EPB41L3, PAX1/NREP-AS1 [Bowden 2025 AUC 0.92])
what_card_DOES_document: VAL-073 Verlaat tissue anchor: Normal vs CIN3 d=+0.73 [+0.22, +1.24] p=0.004 monotonic Normal<CIN3<SCC
VAL-074 Farkas + VAL-081 Lando tissue cohorts read NEGATIVE-direction at total n=313
Most likely explanation: HPV-stratification of normals matters
LBC primary pathway requires cervical-LBC-specific panel engineering for v0.2+

moss_reference_status: cervical_epithelial NOT in Moss 2018 25-tissue reference at v0.1

stage_1_immune_flag.h_min_class_for_stage_1: immune (per panc-LL-007 universal pipeline rule — Stage 1 ALWAYS uses panel-class H_min, not tissue-class)
expected_direction_caveats: VAL-074 Farkas reads − direction (HPV-negative healthy normals shift baseline)
VAL-081 Lando tumors read − direction vs VAL-073 normals at n=270
Cohort-direction-flip per CCL-019 category, NOT bidirectional cancellation per CCL-031

ccl_027_four_questions.q1_test_1_pooled_passes_cleanly: MIXED — passes in VAL-073 (d=+0.73), fails in VAL-074/081
ccl_027_four_questions.q2_directional_panel_needed: Not at v0.1 evidence level. v0.2+ may substitute published clinical panels (FAM19A4, ZNF671, PAX1/NREP-AS1) with dedicated H_min calibration.
ccl_027_four_questions.q3_compartment_specific_scoring: Tissue arm only at v0.1; LBC arm pending v0.2+ engineering. No blood arm tested.
ccl_027_four_questions.q4_test_2_lymphoid_myeloid_split: PLACEHOLDER pending OQ-2026-01 immune-atlas staging. Not runnable at v0.1 per CCL-030.

stage_1_immune_flag.ccl_031_terminology: cervical-epic exhibits cohort-direction-flip pattern (CCL-019 category, like crc-epic). NOT bidirectional cancellation. The pattern is real cohort-design heterogeneity (HPV-stratification of normals), not the AD-instance pooled-null + directional-pass pattern.

specimen_pathways.panel_transferability: validated for tissue with high immune infiltrate

specimen_pathways.validation_state: panel transferability flagged at VAL-076; raw IDAT reprocessing required for VAL-077 v0.2+
specimen_pathways.panel_transferability: NOT established — Xu-538 was buffy-coat trained; LBC is exfoliated cervical epithelium + mucosal-resident lymphocytes (different cell mixture)

specimen_pathways.validation_state: no public per-patient pre-dx cervical blood cohort located at v0.1
specimen_pathways.panel_transferability: validated for plasma cfDNA in other diseases; cervical-specific validation pending

HPV status (negative / 16+ / 18+ / other hr-HPV / multiple) — STAGE 1 STRATIFIER, not just metadata
specimen type (tissue biopsy / LBC / swab / plasma)

validation_summary.diagnostic_note: HPV-negative healthy normals per Farkas 2013 paper read; baseline shift relative to VAL-073

validation_summary.result: EXCLUDED — cohort is HNSCC (head/neck), not cervical (landscape error caught at runtime sample-title check)

Data integrity flag per CCL-032 — supplementary file is residual M-values per Bowden 2025 Methods (NOT raw β); CHK-3.1 distribution check failed: 50% in [0.4, 0.6] vs 12% extremes. Raw IDAT processing through minfi/sesame from GSE287994_RAW.tar required.

validation_summary.result: deferred — data not GEO-deposited, available from corresponding author upon request
External vs VAL-073 normals d=-0.43 [-0.82, -0.04]; only 6.7% of tumors above VAL-073 normal p95

tier_thresholds_v0_1.status: PLACEHOLDER pending v0.2+ panel substitution or HPV-stratified re-run
tier_thresholds_v0_1.rationale: Card cannot lock thresholds at exploratory_with_cohort_heterogeneity tier. Tissue-arm thresholds from VAL-073 alone would be misleading given VAL-074/081 negative-direction at n=313.

saturation_observed_v0_1: No saturation flagged in any VAL run. VAL-077 mean A=1.011 was at 84.8% of immune ceiling but did not exceed runtime flag threshold.
path_to_v0_2_priority_order: 1. Reprocess GSE287994 from raw IDATs through minfi/sesame; rerun VAL-077
2. HPV-stratify all tissue cohorts (VAL-073, VAL-074, VAL-081) with explicit HPV+ vs HPV- subgroups
3. Build cervical-LBC-specific Stage 1 panel trained on LBC β values
4. Substitute published clinical-grade cervical methylation panels (FAM19A4/miR124-2, ZNF671, EPB41L3, PAX1/NREP-AS1) with dedicated H_min calibration as card-specific Stage 1 deviation
5. Run Test 2 lymphoid/myeloid sub-panel split when OQ-2026-01 immune-atlas staging operationalizes
6. Pursue gated cohorts VAL-078 CINCS and VAL-079 Sundström via direct corresponding-author contact
lessons_learned_card_specific: cerv-LL-001 — cervical_epithelial NOT in Moss reference at v0.1 (Stage 2 deconvolution not applicable for primary specimen, which IS the target tissue)
cerv-LL-002 — HPV stratification is a Stage 1 stratifier in cervical, not just metadata
cerv-LL-003 — Cervical_epithelial Salas QC bounds not yet established
cerv-LL-004 — LBC samples have variable cellular composition (epithelium / mucosal lymphocytes / mucus)
cerv-LL-005 — Vaccination status shifts cohort generation
cerv-LL-006 — Per-CpG cohort-mean Δβ direction is descriptive, not mechanism (CCL-030 reaffirmed)
cerv-LL-007 — VAL-073 anchor was originally drafted with bidirectional-cancellation language; CCL-031 closes that drift
cerv-LL-008 — Landscape survey errors caught at runtime, not landscape (VAL-075 HNSCC)
cerv-LL-009 — Supplementary β files are NOT necessarily β values (VAL-077 residual M-values)
cerv-LL-010 — Healthy reference baseline shifts across cohorts are diagnostic (VAL-073 vs VAL-074 +0.06 A-units)
cerv-LL-011 — LBC is not buffy-coat; specimen mixture matters (VAL-076)
cerv-LL-012 — Saturation flag check mandatory before any null outcome
cerv-LL-013 — Per-CpG cohort-mean Δβ percentage descriptive only (CCL-030 reaffirmed at cervical-epic)
cerv-LL-014 — Common sense biology is the first check, not the last (VAL-076/077 reads contradicted clinical-grade panel literature)
cerv-LL-015 — Compaction amnesia is structural failure mode requiring memory #9 absolute rule
cerv-LL-016 — Diagnostic order fixed: data integrity → biology → framework (codified as CCL-032)
